additionalProperties.value: Loads a firmware-directory image and starts it. Reads the 0x800-byte header into pool memory and verifies it; allocates pages at the entry's load address and reads and decrypts the body through the uncached alias (address | 0x80000000). Without a valid signature and with argument 3 zero, a second verifier handles the image instead. Before the jump: writes {'SysI', 0x22028cc0} at boot descriptor 0x2203ff18, copies SysInfo there, stores argument 2 (boot flags) at 0x2203ff10, sets CPSR 0xd3 (SVC, IRQ and FIQ masked) and branches by register to the load address. Returns only on failure.

Selects diagnostic, disk, updater or normal firmware from named firmware-directory images. Before normal OSOS, opens aupd; when its metadata state is zero, runs the power gate, writes state 1 through SetInfo, then loads it. This path mutates firmware metadata. Selector bytes 0x934..0xb5b match between 2.0.4 and 2.0.5; iTunes host sequencing remains unverified.
